_note: Transfer of a movable asset: "the actual cost of such assets to the employer as reduced by the cost of normal wear and tear" and the price paid; for other assets, wear and tear at 10% — "10% in case of other assets, of the cost of the asset for each completed year" (r.15(5) Table IV Sl. 8, Gazette 271092, p.1547; TY 2025-26: Rules 1962 r.3(7)(viii), "10 per cent of such cost for each completed year", consolidated rule 3, p.4). This row is the rate and the method, a WearAndTear definition; AssetPerquisite applies it (D-119 C5; W-154f). For every employee. Every regime. TY 2026-27: Income-tax Rules, 2026 r.15(5) Table IV (Gazette 271092, p.1547). TY 2025-26: Income-tax Rules, 1962 r.3(7) (consolidated rule 3, pp.3–4).
